explain.say: Here is a good sport plan. When I win: smile, say good game, do not boast. When I lose: take a breath, say well done, ask to play again. Games are for fun together. Great job! Your challenge: play a game and try it.

faq.q: Why do I feel so cross when I lose?
faq.a: You wanted to win, and your brain feels disappointed. That can come out as a hot, cross feeling. It is okay to feel it, and it passes.
asks: Tell me about Kwame feels cross

faq.q: What can I say when I lose?
faq.a: You can say, Well done! or Good game! Then you can ask, Can we play again?
asks: Tell me about Breathe, well done
Tell me about When I lose

faq.q: What can I say when I win?
faq.a: Smile and say, Good game! Saying thank you for playing is kind too. Try not to boast.
asks: Tell me about When I win

faq.q: What if the cross feeling is very big?
faq.a: Take a break from the game. Squeeze your hands, take slow breaths, and come back later. A grown-up you trust can help.

faq.q: Why should I keep playing if I might lose?
faq.a: Every game helps you get better. Losing is part of playing, and the fun is in playing together.

facts: Saying Good game after a match is a tradition in many sports around the world.
Even top players lose many games while they learn.

quiz.say: You lose a game. What can you say?
quiz.show: You lose. What can you say?
quiz.why: Well done is kind, and makes your friend want to play again.

wrong.1: Saying unfair can make your friend feel sad.
wrong.2: One loss is okay. You can play again.

quiz.say: How does the winner feel when you say well done?
quiz.why: Kind words make the winner feel happy and want to play again.

wrong.1: Kind words do not make people cross.
wrong.2: There is nothing scary about well done.
